BiblicalUsage: Yeçôwd is the foundation, the bottom on which everything stands. The blood of the bullock was poured beside the bottom of the altar, and a third part of the people stood at the gate of the foundation in the days of Joash. Ezekiel warns that the wall daubed with untempered mortar shall fall and its foundation be discovered, and Habakkuk says God went forth for salvation, discovering the foundation of the wicked.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every building is judged by its foundation, and the wall that is not founded on God will fall. My position is that the foundation of my life is not my work but His, and He will not let it be moved. And I hold that God discovers the foundation of the wicked, and He lays the foundation of His people, and both are His work.
